**Participants:** Wren Duskfield (Ops Lead)

Wren: "Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week: accounts, pairing rotation, and a shadow shift. It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter."

positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsLegitimateCurrentProcedure
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the settled, mandatory onboarding procedure rather than one option among others?
positions.why: src-1 states the checklist as a universal mandate ('Every new hire completes...') and src-2 supplies its provenance as the thing that superseded a prior system ('replaced the old wiki page last quarter'). Read together in the flat, matter-of-fact procedural register both carry, the two expressions jointly do the work of grounding the checklist's institutional authority: one names the requirement, the other names the supersession that makes it the current legitimate artifact rather than an ad hoc addition. No tension between them — they read as two beats of the same institutional claim.
